issues.failure_explanation: The displayed definition of A_h in (s2.10) uses coefficient -1 for the interior convection face jump, while the coercivity proof and adjoint-consistency argument use the coefficient -1/2 in a sum over all element faces. For a genuinely discontinuous u_h these two bilinear forms differ by an interior jump term, so the stated discrete problem is not the adjoint-consistent form that is subsequently analyzed.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the interior convection term in (s2.10) by the face-based adjoint-consistent term -1/2 sum over elements, or replace the form used in the proofs by the defined form and redo the affected estimates.
issues.overall_effect: The discrete DG formulation used in the error analysis and adaptive algorithm is inconsistent with the one defined in (s2.10); all results relying on the adjoint-consistent convection term are affected until the definition and proofs are aligned.
issues.title: Convection face term in A_h does not match the adjoint-consistent form used in proofs
issues.why_classification: The mismatch is a local coefficient/definition error; correcting it to the form already used in the proofs preserves the stated method and conclusions without new architecture.

issues.failure_explanation: Integration by parts for the adjoint BVP gives the strong residual -μΔu* - div(u*⊗β) + ∇p* = f (for div β = 0). The displayed computation changes the preceding term -∫ v_h : μΔu* into +μΔu* in the final line, so the claimed adjoint consistency identity is not proved as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the sign of the Laplacian term in the final line so that the strong adjoint residual appears with the sign implied by integration by parts.
issues.overall_effect: The adjoint DG consistency lemma is a key input for adjoint a priori estimates and eigenvalue residual arguments; the sign error makes that input unproved.
issues.title: Sign error in adjoint consistency calculation
issues.why_classification: The defect is a single calculation sign; the intended lemma survives after the local correction.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof needs a bound for the full DG norm |||u^f - Π_h u^f|||, including the face term h_F|{∇(u^f - Π_h u^f)}|^2. issues.failure_explanation: The displayed triangle argument compares |||u - u_h||| with |||λT u - λT_h u||| but then bounds a different quantity |||λT_h u - λ_h T_h u_h|||. Since T_h u is the discrete solution for RHS u, while u_h = λ_h^{-1} T_h u_h only when u_h is used as RHS, the inequality does not follow. The claimed equivalence in (s2.91) and the resulting eigenfunction/eigenvalue rates are therefore not proved.

issues.failure_explanation: The adjoint discrete residual is naturally \tilde A_h(v, u* - u_h*) (test function first), as proved in (s3.13). The theorem statement instead uses \tilde A_h(u* - u_h*, v), which is a different sesquilinear expression because of the convection term. The proof's claim that the same argument gives (s3.9) does not establish the statement as written.

issues.failure_explanation: The estimator η_J is defined with the full tensor boundary trace u_h⊗n. Equation (s3.26) equates its boundary part to the scalar normal component (u_h-u)·n. Since u=0 on ∂Ω, these are different quantities for a general non-tangential discrete velocity, so the displayed equality is false.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the scalar boundary term in (s3.26) by the full trace (u_h-u)⊗n, or redefine η_J consistently.
